title: Certificate
description:
A certificate contains information to be installed on a gateway to secure the traffic going
through it.
For more information, see
[API Gateway Concepts](/iaas/Content/APIGateway/Concepts/apigatewayconcepts.htm).

certificate.description: The data of the leaf certificate in pem format.

compartmentId.description:
The [OCID](/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the compartment in which the
resource is created.

additionalProperties.description: The value of the tag. Only the String type is supported.

Key-value pair representing a defined tag key and value, scoped to a
namespace.

Example: `{"CostCenter": "42"}`

definedTags.description:
Defined tags for this resource. Each key is predefined and scoped to a
namespace. For more information, see
[Resource Tags](/Content/General/Concepts/resourcetags.htm).

Example: `{"Operations": {"CostCenter": "42"}}`

displayName.description:
A user-friendly name. Does not have to be unique, and it's changeable.
Avoid entering confidential information.

Example: `My new resource`

freeformTags.description:
Free-form tags for this resource. Each tag is a simple key-value pair
with no predefined name, type, or namespace. For more information, see
[Resource Tags](/Content/General/Concepts/resourcetags.htm).

Example: `{"Department": "Finance"}`

intermediateCertificates.description: The intermediate certificate data associated with the certificate in pem format.

lifecycleDetails.description:
A message describing the current state in more detail.
For example, can be used to provide actionable information for a
resource in a Failed state.

lifecycleState.description: The current state of the certificate.

subjectNames.description: The entity to be secured by the certificate and additional host names.

additionalProperties.description: The value of the tag. Only string type is supported.

Key-value pair representing system tags' keys and values scoped to a namespace.
Example: `{"bar-key": "value"}`

systemTags.description:
System tags for this resource. Each key is predefined and scoped to a namespace.
Example: `{"orcl-cloud": {"free-tier-retained": "true"}}`

timeCreated.description: The time this resource was created. An RFC3339 formatted datetime string.

timeNotValidAfter.description: The date and time the certificate will expire.

timeUpdated.description: The time this resource was last updated. An RFC3339 formatted datetime string.

ResourceLock.description:
Resource locks are used to prevent certain APIs from being called for the resource.
A full lock prevents both updating the resource and deleting the resource. A delete
lock prevents deleting the resource.

message.description:
A message added by the creator of the lock. This is typically used to give an
indication of why the resource is locked.

relatedResourceId.description: The id of the resource that is locking this resource. Indicates that deleting this resource will remove the lock.
